description: Source code for 'git show-branch' command, implementing branch and commit visualization with ref handling, sorting, and display options.

classes.name: commit_name
classes.description: Represents a commit's name and its relation to a branch head, including generation count.

methods.name: interesting
methods.description: Selects a commit from the priority queue that is not marked as uninterested.

methods.name: commit_to_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name information associated with a commit.

methods.name: name_commit
methods.description: Assigns a name to a commit based on its position relative to a branch head.

methods.name: name_parent
methods.description: Names the parent of a commit, updating its generation count.

methods.name: name_first_parent_chain
methods.description: Names the chain of first-parent commits starting from a given commit.

methods.name: name_commits
methods.description: Names all commits in a list, assigning branch head names and generations.

methods.name: mark_seen
methods.description: Marks a commit as seen if it hasn't been marked already.

methods.name: join_revs
methods.description: Joins multiple revisions into a combined set, marking commits as interesting or uninterested.

methods.name: show_one_commit
methods.description: Displays a commit's details, including abbreviated hash and message.

methods.name: append_one_rev
methods.description: Adds a revision to the list based on a reference name or glob pattern.

methods.name: git_show_branch_config
methods.description: Handles configuration options for show-branch command.

methods.name: omit_in_dense
methods.description: Determines if a commit should be omitted in dense display mode based on its relevance.

methods.name: cmd_show_branch
methods.description: Main function implementing the show-branch command, handling options, refs, and commit display.
